purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Import Depot Activity Empty Depot Assignment details.
features: Empty Depot Assignment allows the user to assign/update Empty depot for a BL according to the Empty Pickup and Return setup.
Selected PR container should not be in Prepared, Cancelled or Freeze status.

events.description: Assigns/updates the Empty depot of the selected BL records according to the Empty Pickup and Return setup.
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more BL records using the check boxes, clicks the ☰ icon at Voyage level in Depot Activity and selects "Empty Depot Assignment".
